resource_notes: GGPO contribution remains 7 bytes per participant; button and aim arrays are fixed size.
Adapter hardware is recomputed only on topology changes, not each frame.
Client UI hardware updates are not sent back to host. Unchanged host controller values do not trigger new snapshots.
limits: No claim of full commercial game coverage.
This batch used two Linux processes for live netplay and native Windows for hardware protocols, not a live Windows-to-Linux network run.
Master Tap single-port fixture power-resets its CPU together with the adapter: its on-wire four-state counter has no reset command.
